entries.clue: Mashed alongside tatties on the table for Burns Night, north of the border
Grey seabird, stiff of wing, that glides the cliff face and spits oil
Where the working horses stand in their loose boxes overnight
Ground where black grouse gather at dawn to strut, bubble and spar
Youngster lately out of the nest, still shouting to be fed and landing badly
Fire giant with a blazing sword who rides from the south to burn the worlds at the end
Named on a pub menu, but he really walked behind two horses all day long
Young female bird not yet a year old, just coming into lay
Stone-hearted giant who chased the raven-god home and died duelling the thunderer
Young cow that has not yet borne her first, waiting to join the dairy
Keeper of the youth-giving apples, lured into a wood and snatched by a giant in bird shape
Eldest of the fate-sisters, the past in person; the gods hold court beside her fountain
Memory, the raven its one-eyed master fears the more to lose on its daily flight
Tiny brown scrap of a bird, tail cocked skyward, song absurdly loud for its size
